delivery.connected: 393 and 1280 pixel cases passed generation, reload, locks, approval, SVG, exact 3D, chat revision and logout in critical and Async workflows. 393 no-WebGL retained 2D/save/approval/export/recovery.
delivery.roof: Approval invalidation confirmation, one new draft, historical approval preservation, roof preference through reload/regeneration, restoration and lock refusal without head/history/provider-count mutation all passed. Later conceptual approval succeeded.
delivery.revision_guards: Held comparison disabled revision selection; historical revision stayed read-only; forced historical roof event produced zero writes and unchanged head/history; production-function race witness passed.

authentication_and_recovery.scope: Controlled synthetic provider, not real accounts or paid provider calls.

security.scope: Current feed observation for this head; no suppression; no guarantee against undiscovered or future vulnerabilities.
